description:
Freeze ONE widget's figures and return a link that opens it on its own web page for someone who cannot sign in to Well: an accountant, an investor, a bank, a colleague outside the workspace.

Use it when the person asks to send, forward, share or give a link to a figure or table already on screen ("send this cash position to my accountant", "give my bank something to forward"), whether or not they say "link". The figure is already drawn, so this is the whole job: call this tool straight away, with no read of the data first and no question back. For a saved BOARD of several blocks use well_share_canvas instead: a board link freezes every block together. Do not call it when the person only asks about a figure ("is that more than last month?"): nobody asked to send it.

HOW: the widget the person is looking at was drawn by one earlier tool call, visible earlier in this conversation. Call no other tool first, not even to re-read the figures. Pass `tool_name` (the tool that drew the widget) and `arguments` (the arguments of that earlier call, copied exactly: the same keys, the same values, nothing added, nothing dropped, no default filled in). Well runs that tool again as the caller, checks the result the way the in-app card does, and freezes what it returns. This tool has no field for figures. Some widgets (a cash position, burn, runway, cash forecast, cash flow bridge, cost structure, monthly pivot, MRR or category trend card) take the figures themselves as their arguments, because the figures were computed before the card was drawn: Well re-checks those figures and does not measure them again. For those, `arguments` carries the figures, so copy them exactly as the card was drawn and never retype, round, estimate or recompute one.

Shareable widgets: well_render_runway, well_render_cash_forecast, well_render_cash_flow_bridge, well_render_burn, well_render_mrr, well_render_cash_position, well_render_cost_structure, well_render_category_trend, well_render_customer_ltv, well_render_monthly_pivot, well_get_vat_summary, well_show_records. Any other widget is refused with a `refused_reason`: it acts on the workspace, is a to-do list or a setting, or holds personal detail. Say it cannot be shared by link and why; never offer a link anyway. A records table the person gave custom columns, a cost breakdown grouped by ledger account, and a payee table with a row that has no catalog category are refused too: say what to change, and never retry with figures retyped.

WHAT THE READER SEES: the widget as it was at the moment of sharing, with a date: the date its figures were measured when the result states it, otherwise the date the link was made. Never tell the person the figures were measured at that moment. It does not follow the data afterwards. Salary and payroll lines show as totals only, never as one line per person. The page is read-only: it cannot change anything, and a change the reader asks for opens a page in Well that needs a sign-in.

THE LIMITS: the link stops opening after 7 days unless `expires_in_days` says otherwise (at most 30), and after 20 opens unless `max_opens` says otherwise (at most 200). Every page load counts as an open, a refresh included. Pass them only when the person states a limit.

The link is returned ONCE, here. Give it to the person who asked in the same reply, with: when it expires, how many times it opens, that anyone holding the link can read those figures, that salary shows as totals only, and that you can stop the link at any time with well_revoke_widget_shares. Do not repeat the figures as if they were the link's content.

When the token authorizes one workspace, call this directly — no other tool call is needed first. When it authorizes several, this read will not guess which one you mean: pass `workspace_id` on the call.

arguments.description: The arguments of that earlier call, copied exactly: no field added, none dropped, no default filled in. Never figures typed by hand.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the link stops opening. Omit for 7.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

max_opens.description: How many times the link opens. Omit for 20.

tool_name.description: The tool that drew the widget, for example well_render_cash_position.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

name: well_share_widget

computed_by.description: "caller" when the figures were computed before the card was drawn and Well only re-checked them, "server" when Well measured them.

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. Start the reply with one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

resolved_at.description: When the link was made. For a widget with figures computed beforehand, this is not when they were measured.

resolved_workspace.description: The workspace that answered, when the caller named none and the token authorizes several.

share_link_id.description: Names this link for well_revoke_widget_shares. Not something to give the reader.

url.description: The link to give the person who asked. Returned once and never again.

title: Share a widget by link
